Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: In the final synthesis, the Planner correctly noted that Roberto Rossellini (director of The Machine to Kill Bad People) died earlier (1977) than Giuliano Carnimeo (director of Poker in Bed, 2016), but then drew the wrong conclusion by stating Poker in Bed had the director who died earlier and even misattributed Rossellini to Poker in Bed. This is a misattribution and reversed-conclusion error during the final consolidation.
